podcast.body: Appearing on the "Judgment Night" soundtrack, this track was utilized by Ash Boo Shultz of USS in a unique stage act. He would play it from a cassette alongside a self-help tape to disrupt the brain and make the audience uncomfortable. "And then on this one, I'd have like you're just another victim by helmet and house of pain from the judgmentite soundtrack."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: USS In Their Own Words: Part 2

podcast.body: House of Pain collaborated with Helmet on the song "Just Another Victim" for the 1993 *Judgment Night* soundtrack. This "ground breaking" collaboration was part of a radical experiment to pair rock and hip-hop acts, serving as a major catalyst for the rap rock and nu metal genres that became very big later in the decade. "It's Helmut and House of Pain with just another victim."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
